title: Crispy Chicken Thighs With Cucumber Yogurt

instructions: ["Position a rack in the bottom third of the oven and heat to 350 degrees.", "Pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel and season both sides with 1 teaspoon each salt and pepper.", "Place the thighs skin side down in a large, cold, preferably cast-iron skillet. Place the skillet over medium heat and cook the thighs for 5 minutes without moving them. title: Crispy Hash Brown Chicken Cutlets
ingredients: [{"name": "1\u00bd cups/202 grams all-purpose flour, plus more as needed", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "3 large eggs", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "Salt and black pepper", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "2 teaspoons paprika", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "2 teaspoons garlic powder", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "6 thin-sliced chicken cutlets (about 1\u00be pounds total)", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "7 to 8 cups frozen shredded hash browns (about 20 ounces)", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "Neutral oil, for frying, such as sunflower, grapeseed or avocado oil", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "\u00bc cup mayonnaise", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "\u00bc cup ketchup", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "2 teaspoons vinegary hot sauce, such as Tabasco", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "Salt and black pepper", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}]
instructions: ["Prepare the dredging station:", "To a small sheet pan or wide shallow bowl, add 1 cup of flour. To a second small sheet pan or wide shallow bowl, add the eggs, a pinch of salt and a few cracks of black pepper. Whisk until combined.", "Add the frozen hash browns to a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in 1-minute intervals, until the potatoes have reached room temperature, 2 to 3 minutes. Place the potatoes on a sheet pan or 9-by-13-inch baking dish. Add \u00bd cup flour and toss to combine.", "Season the chicken cutlets on both sides with salt, pepper, paprika and garlic powder (or use spice mix of choice instead of paprika and garlic).", "Coat all the cutlets:", "Dip the cutlets in flour on both sides. Shake off any excess flour and dip in egg on both sides. Dip in the potato mixture, pressing down the cutlet to ensure the potatoes adhere to both sides until coated (a few small bare patches are fine), then transfer to a lightly oiled baking sheet. (If needed, work with oiled hands when transferring the chicken to prevent the hash brown layer from sticking to your hands.)", "Cook the chicken:", "If you\u2019d like, heat the oven to 250 degrees so that you can keep the cutlets warm after you fry them. Set a wire cooling rack on a large baking sheet. Fill a deep 12-inch skillet with 1 \u00bd to 2 inches of oil and place over medium heat; heat to 375 degrees. (You can test the oil by adding a sprinkle of hash brown mixture: If it simply floats on the surface, the oil is too cold. If it maintains a vigorous sizzle and turns golden in a minute or two, the oil is ready.)", "Using lightly oiled hands to prevent sticking, press a cutlet between your palms and press to ensure the potato layer adheres to the chicken. Working in batches, carefully lower the chicken into the oil (A large turner spatula is handy for transferring the cutlets to the frying pan.) You can fry two cutlets at once, but avoid overcrowding.", "Fry for about 6 minutes, until the edges and bottom turn golden brown. Carefully flip using tongs (or two sets of tongs for more control) and continue frying for about 4 minutes more, until golden brown on both sides, crispy and cooked through. Adjust the heat as needed to ensure the chicken isn\u2019t browning too fast, maintaining a steady sizzle temperature. (Don\u2019t hesitate to flip the cutlet again if you\u2019d like more browning on the other side.)", "Carefully transfer the chicken to the wire rack and sprinkle with salt; transfer to the oven to keep warm if desired. Repeat with remaining chicken.", "Make the fry sauce:", "In a small bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, ketchup, hot sauce and a pinch of salt and pepper. Stir to combine. Serve crispy chicken with fry sauce alongside for dipping."]

instructions: ["Make the dough:", "To a medium mixing bowl, add the all-purpose flour, rye flour, Cheddar, pumpkin seeds and salt and toss to combine. instructions: ["Prepare the stock: Shuck corn, reserving cobs. Using a paring knife, slice kernels into a medium bowl. ingredients: [{"name": "2 large eggs", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "1 cup/52 grams panko bread crumbs", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "\u00bd cup fresh flat-leaf parsley (stems and leaves), finely chopped", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "\u00bc cup/65 grams whole-milk Greek yogurt", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "4 tablespoons olive oil, divided", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "3 garlic cloves, minced", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "2 shallots, minced or \u00bd small onion, minced", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "2 teaspoons onion powder, optional (see Tip)", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "1\u00bd teaspoons dried thyme", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "1\u00bd teaspoons celery seeds", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "1 teaspoon dried rosemary", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "1 tablespoon coarse kosher salt, such as Diamond Crystal (see Tip)", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "Black pepper", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "2 pounds ground turkey, preferably 94% lean or less", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "1 tablespoon cornstarch", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "1 tablespoon cold water", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "1 cup chicken broth", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "Juice of 1 large lemon (about 3 tablespoons lemon juice)", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}, {"name": "1 tablespoon unsalted butter", "quantity": 0, "unit": "", "notes": ""}]
